claims.quote: A vacuum-operated gripper head for transporting perforated objects. The gripper head includes a plurality of naps which penetrate into the perforations of the object to be moved in order to seal the perforations.
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum-operated gripper head for transporting objects, which is a type of grip unit, but it does not specify it is for a hand-operated laying device or for use with a suction plate.

claims.quote: The gripper head G may include a housing 5 having a generally U-shaped cross-section. The housing 5 also includes a connector 6 for attaching the gripper head to the suction device S through the flexible vacuum hose L.
claims.note: The reference discloses a housing and a suction device (vacuum generating device), but it does not explicitly mention a 'grip portion for gripping the grip unit' or that the vacuum generating device is 'electrically operated'.

claims.note: The reference does not describe the grip portion as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor does it mention a sound-damping device.
This reference describes a vacuum-operated gripper head for transporting perforated objects, but it does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
This reference does not describe a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference describes a gripper head and a suction device, but it does not specify a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion of the housing.
This reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference does not describe a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not describe an air collection device, such as an air collection screw, arranged upstream of a grip portion in a first housing portion for collecting exhaust air.
This reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion in a second housing portion for guiding exhaust air to an air outlet.

This reference does not describe a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
This reference does not disclose air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
